senses.gloss: piṇḍ-ādāna (EI 12), quit rent. Cf. also piṇḍa-kara.

piṇḍaka (Ep. Ind., Vol. IV, p. 254, text line 55), same as piṇḍ-ādāna or bhāga-bhoga; cf. samucita-kara-piṇḍak-ādi-samasta-pratyāya; taxes assessed in a lump; cf. piṇḍa-kara.
 (IA 2), same as grāsā; probably, a part of the produce of the fields for the maintenance of certain persons.
 (HRS), known from Pāla records; same as hiraṇya, according to some.
 (LL), probably, a slab.
piṇḍa-kara (HRS), lump assessment upon villages, as suggested by the Arthaśāstra. Cf. also piṇḍ-ādāna.
